scope: Independent morphological judgment of model choices and display obligations, followed by final mechanical reconciliation by the coordinator.
conclusion: The proposed 24 matrices and explicit derivations can represent all 42 nominal and adjectival systems and 730 cells. No hidden new class is left to diagnostic forms alone.
findings: Literal kinship tables preserve unchanged singular genitives, mutated datives, short dohtor, and the distinct selected plurals. The newly added accepted-variant metadata must accompany those tables.

outstanding_at_review: No unresolved source display requirement. The diagnostic rows now retain accepted variants and exact source-headword normalization; final rendered-page inspection belongs to the coordinator and independent reviewer.
final_reconciliation: All 730 literal or explicitly derived surfaces independently recomputed and matched the final source inventory; 344 literal cells and 386 derived cells.
